title: Brainstorm x3w: Propose approaches
description: Propose two to three architecture approaches with tradeoffs and a recommendation.
notes: Decision: use the System Stack approach. Campaigns bind to one base rules system plus an explicitly ordered compatible add-on stack; lookup and validation resolve deterministically through that stack; D&D and Pathfinder character creation dispatch through system-specific validators behind shared seams.
close_reason: Presented alternatives and user approved System Stack approach.
